demos.title: Foundation Chat
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. This is the smallest production-ready chat slice and the recommended first install.

demos.title: RAG Chatbot
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Uses a portable sample retrieval index by default; add DATABASE_URL and pgvector when you want custom document indexing.

demos.title: Multimodal Chatbot
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Use a model that can process the image or PDF parts you send.

demos.title: Object Generation
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Keep the route model aligned with the structured output schema.

demos.title: Generative UI
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform. Uses hosted web_search plus local UI tools for comparison and recommendation components.

demos.title: Minimal Chat Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform with an openai/* chat model. Uses OpenAI hosted web_search, public GitHub REST lookup, and questionnaire-driven human tool output.

demos.title: Memory & Persistence Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Uses visitor-scoped in-memory persistence by default; add DATABASE_URL when you want Postgres-backed memories and compaction checkpoints.

demos.title: Streaming Chat Shell
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Useful as the smallest replayable streaming shell after Foundation Chat.

demos.title: Loop Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Use a model with reliable tool-calling behavior for the approval loop.

demos.title: Trace Eval Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. It adds trace, deterministic checks, and judge output around one research run.

demos.title: Persistent Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Uses in-memory chats and local streams by default; add DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL when you want durable chats and resumable streams.

demos.title: Sandbox Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Runs a local sandbox and local preview route by default; Vercel Sandbox credentials are optional for remote sandbox execution.

demos.title: Skills Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default. Runs skill loading and file tools in a local sandbox by default; Vercel Sandbox credentials are optional for remote execution.

demos.title: MCP Agent
demos.setup: OpenAI Platform by default for the base chat. Local Next.js runtime inspection depends on the installed MCP tooling.

demos.title: OpenAI Agents SDK Demo
demos.setup: Complete full-stack OpenAI Agents SDK install. OpenAI Platform powers the default chat. The native project key also supports realtime voice when its public transport is wired.

demos.title: LangGraph Agent
demos.setup: Requires a separately running LangGraph backend. Start local-first with apps/langgraph-agent-api on http://localhost:2024 and set OPENAI_API_KEY on the backend for OpenAI models. Then set LANGGRAPH_AGENT_API_URL, LANGGRAPH_AGENT_ASSISTANT_ID, and LANGGRAPH_AGENT_API_KEY in the installed Next.js app.

demos.title: Ultra Chatbot Agent
demos.setup: Complete full-stack Ultra install. Configure OpenAI Platform, Postgres, Redis, Vercel Blob, and Vercel Sandbox credentials. OpenAI Platform, Postgres, and Redis support the default chat; Blob and Sandbox drive Ultra uploads and sandbox execution.

demos.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway
demos.setup: IMAGE_GATEWAY selects cloudflare (default) or vercel. Vercel uses AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY. Cloudflare uses account, gateway and gateway token with request BYOK, stored BYOK or Unified Billing.
